images.caption:
Picture of the Marsalis Street Bus 1213; according to the Warren Commission, Oswald is aboard at time of this photo. Oswald got out after four minutes: the bus got stuck in the traffic around Dealey Plaza. A cab took him to his rooming house where he arrived at 1:00 pm - only thirty minutes after the assassination.

Photo appears to be taken from south side of 700 block of Elm Street (US 67 / 77 / 80) just east of Market Street.
